what_i_see: Small linear chain of three clumps ~3" long running SE to NW at centre: an orange compact knot at the SE end, a whitish middle clump, and bluer elongated clumps to the NW.
most_likely: A clumpy star-forming galaxy or small merger chain at z~1.
against_it: Lens reading weak: the red knot sits at the end of the chain, not on its concave side.
decisive_test: Resolved spectroscopy (or deeper multi-band photo-z per clump) to test a common redshift.
catalogue_notes: Legacy DR8 photo-z EXP z=0.99+/-0.48 at 0.7" (low quality). Nearest NED WISE sources ~11-12". No SIMBAD/Gaia within 30". No match in Jacobs+2019, Huang+2020/2021 (cone 10"; Rojas+2022 query unvalidated).
